lines.text: Welcome to the wonderful world of reading.

It has nine spots, says Gus.
Nice, says Pete.

It caught a fly, he says.
Neat, says Pete.
Pete finds a green caterpillar in the flower pot.
I will bring it home to show mom and dad, he says.
Mom helps Pete build a home for the caterpillar.
They use a big jar.
Dad puts lots of little holes in the lid for air.
Pete puts the caterpillar in the jar.
Pete puts some leaves in the jar for the caterpillar to eat.
He adds a twig for it to crawl on.

Goodnight, Pete, says dad.
Goodnight, caterpillar, says Pete.
When Pete wakes up, the caterpillar is gone.
Where did it go?
Did it run away?
It is not gone, says mom.
It did not run away, says dad.
Look, they say.
The caterpillar is inside there, says mom.
It is called a pupa.
Will it stay in there forever?
Pete asks.
No, says dad.
The caterpillar is changing into something new.
What will it become?
Pete asks.
It is a surprise, says mom.
We must wait and see.
Pete waits.
Callie comes to visit.
Did it come out yet?
She asks.
Not yet, says Pete.
Pete waits some more.
Gus comes to visit.
Did it come out yet?
He asks.
Not yet, says Pete.
Pete waits even longer.
Marty comes to visit.
Did it come out yet?
He asks.
Not yet, says Pete.
Pete waits.
And waits.
And waits.

Something is happening, says Pete.

Everyone comes over to watch.
The pupa cracks open.

One Easter morning, Pete the Cat discovers his Easter basket is missing!

Hurry up, Pete, Mom says.

It left without him.
Pete starts to walk.
Walking is not cool, he says.

But that bird is cool.
Pete gets to school.
He sits down.
Pete, you are late, his teacher says.

Now Pete is happy.

He loves to use lots of colors.
Pete opens his bag.
Oh no!
His crayons are not there.
They must be at home.

It has only one color.
This art is not groovy, he says.

His song is groovy.
Pete starts to feel better.
Oh no!

He cannot play anymore.
I do not feel cool, Pete says.

He wants to go home.

You look sad, Callie says.
What is wrong?

Nothing has gone my way.
Today is not groovy, Pete says.
